headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber with stronger cyber-task results and scope-alignment claims
summary: OpenAI announced GPT-6 Cyber on 5 November 2026 as a cyber-specialized model for authorized security research, initially restricted to approved Daybreak Red customers. OpenAI reports 48.5% on ExploitGym versus 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber, 40.3% recall on a new web-penetration evaluation versus 32.0% for GPT-6 Astra, and a 0.07% out-of-scope honeypot exploitation rate without deployment safety instructions (0% with them). The system card reports 90/288 FrontierCyber challenges solved, below Astra’s 96/288, with neither model solving the 15 hardest challenges. OpenAI also attributes 948 working Linux-kernel exploits and 81 high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities to its research campaign; Mozilla’s advisory lists some OpenAI-affiliated reporters among fixes but does not validate the full totals or model contribution. The card also reports a 20.29% final-response blocker-reporting flag rate, between GPT-5.6 Sol (34.18%) and GPT-6 Astra (11.66%); OpenAI says most reviewed cases had disclosed the blocker earlier but omitted it from the final answer. These performance and campaign figures remain provider-reported and have not been independently reproduced here.
